title: —Per vias rectas,
html_source: “By straight roads” – the motto of Sir John Blackwood.

anchor.prefix:
in me too, Mr Deasy said. On the spindle side. But I am descended from sir John Blackwood who voted for the union. We are all Irish, all kings' sons. 

 — Alas, Stephen said. 

 —
anchor.suffix:
Mr Deasy said firmly, was his motto. He voted for it and put on his topboots to ride to Dublin from the Ards of Down to do so.

Lal the ral the ra 
The rocky road to Dub
